morphology.shape: Spherical to oval budding yeast with a thick polysaccharide capsule
morphology.size: Cell body 4-10 µm; capsule can extend well beyond this

habitat.naturalHabitat: Soil contaminated with bird droppings, especially pigeon droppings, and decaying wood in tree hollows
habitat.hostAssociation: Environmental fungus; opportunistic pathogen, especially in patients with impaired cell-mediated immunity such as HIV/AIDS
habitat.environmentalOccurrence: Found worldwide in soil enriched with bird excreta and around certain tree species

microscopy.appearance: Encapsulated budding yeast — the capsule appears as a clear halo against the dark India ink background

culture.media: Sabouraud dextrose agar; birdseed (niger seed) agar for pigment production
culture.growthCharacteristics: Grows at 37°C — an important pathogenicity trait
culture.pigmentation: Brown pigment on birdseed agar via melanin production (phenol oxidase)

identificationClues: Encapsulated yeast visible as a clear halo on India ink preparation of CSF
Brown pigment (melanin) on birdseed/niger seed agar

diseases: Cryptococcal meningitis/meningoencephalitis — especially in HIV/AIDS and other immunocompromised patients
virulenceFactors: Polysaccharide capsule — antiphagocytic, main virulence factor
Melanin production — protects against oxidative host defenses
clinicalImportance.transmission: Inhalation of desiccated yeast cells or spores from the environment; not transmitted person to person
clinicalImportance.epidemiology: A major cause of meningitis in people with advanced HIV/AIDS globally, particularly in resource-limited settings with a high HIV burden
clinicalImportance.labSignificance: India ink stain of CSF and cryptococcal antigen (CrAg) testing are the key rapid diagnostic tools

examFacts.keyBiochemicalReaction: Urease positive; melanin production on birdseed agar
examFacts.importantTest: India ink stain of CSF; cryptococcal antigen (CrAg) test
examFacts.distinguishingFeature: Prominent polysaccharide capsule visible on India ink preparation
